title: Step of an embedded machine
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ be an embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and let $M$ be a Turing machine with $m$ work tapes. For any $k$-tape contents and head positions, any output prefix, and any configuration $c$ of $M$, taking one step of the machine obtained by embedding $M$ into $k$ work tapes from the configuration formed by embedding $c$ with those contents, head positions, and output prefix gives the configuration formed by embedding the result of one step of $M$ from $c$ with the same contents, head positions, and output prefix.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
Contents for each of the $k$ tapes
Head positions for each of the $k$ tapes
